title: Atomic Knowledge page frontmatter
description: The frontmatter block every page in this corpus carries. The set stays small on purpose: the page title comes from the leading H1, which has to exist for GitHub anyway, and the validation tier comes from the ledger when the docs site syncs the corpus. A key that duplicates either one is a second source of truth that drifts, so no other key is accepted.

scope.description: One sentence naming what the page covers. The docs site renders it as the page description, which is the meta description of the page and its line in /llms.txt.
examples: Attribute data precedence across template, asset immutable, and asset mutable layers

depends-on.description: Corpus-relative paths of the pages whose facts this page builds on. The docs site passes the list through to the rendered page metadata.

key-modules.description: The pinned sources this page was validated against, one entry per source. The docs site passes the list through to the rendered page metadata.
